title: Q-RUNS-ON-2: Ultrastable's own dashboard and cockpit adopt the runtime shell (top bar, status vocabulary, mark)
body:
**Owner:** design-manager
**Trigger:** RUNS-ON-1 merged (brand/shell)
**Done check:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::usStatusPanel
**Status:** closed

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=dashboard/worker.js
code-anchor: function ownerPage() {

Ultrastable runs on itself, so its own surfaces show the same runtime shell every instance shows. Inline brand/shell/artifact/ultrastable-shell.js into dashboard/worker.js (and the cockpit render in foundation/cockpit.py once the loop-porting branch has merged), put usTopBar at the top of the owner page and usStatusPanel under it, fed from ops/criticality.jsonl (k, chain), the ignition gaps once Q-CRIT-IGNITION lands, the loop registry and ops/cost.jsonl. Add a dashboard test that the owner page carries data-us-shell and the seven vocabulary tiles.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:dashboard/worker.js::usStatusPanel

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 171.3 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
